w:r.w:t: -Obed is a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Public Administration, Nasarawa State University, Keffi, and the Director of the Centre for Gender Studies. Her area of specialization is Public Policy and Gender Analysis. Her research interests include gender, public policy, governance, women’s empowerment, and development.

She holds a Ph.D. in Public Administration and master’s degrees in Public Administration and Gender Studies. Before becoming Director in February 2026, she served as Deputy Director (Academics) and Deputy Director of Programs at the Centre for Gender Studies.

Hassan Ahmed II is a Lecturer I in the Department of Entrepreneurship Studies, Nasarawa State University, Keffi, and serves as the Part-Time Coordinator of the Department. Her area of specialization is Entrepreneurship, with interests in women entrepreneurship, innovation, and business development.

She holds a Ph.D. in Business Administration and has published books and research articles in entrepreneurship and related areas. She has also held various academic and administrative positions within the University.

Personal Assistant to the Director, Centre for Gender Studies

With experience in digital communication, journalism, digital marketing, and content management, Ifeoma supports the Centre’s academic, research, advocacy, and stakeholder-engagement initiatives while contributing to its professional communication and digital visibility.
